subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question that follows.

The numbers in different sections indicate the number of people who belong to different countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64d570a80517865ca724d5609ac4a3af0b8b54afcb593ccec64f73d31ed62ead.png] 

What number represents the people who belong to India, Canada as well as Russia?
solution:
The number of people who belong to India, Canada as well as Russia is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69d070148d75f2fd9ff7b4715d4a73533ceb1f87ec5a4be27dba1db308b59e7b.png] 

The common section of Rectangle, Triangle and Circle representing India, Russia and Canada respectively shows 4.

Hence, the correct answer is **"4"**.
